rules.name: Duty Before All
rules.effect: ^^**Grey Knights Terminator**^^ units from your army are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

stratagems.name: Giants of the Battlefield
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in your unit.
stratagems.summary: +1 Attacks to unit's melee weapons.

stratagems.name: Unending Fidelity
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not shot or fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can shoot or fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.summary: Each destroyed model that hasn't acted this phase: roll D6, on 4+ it shoots/fights then is removed.

stratagems.name: Point-blank Purgation
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, storm bolter weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PISTOL] and [TWIN-LINKED] abilities.
stratagems.summary: Storm bolters gain [PISTOL] and [TWIN-LINKED].

stratagems.name: Grind Them Underfoot
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.cond: That GREY KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit, then roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).
stratagems.summary: Roll D6 for each model in Engagement Range; 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound (max 6).

stratagems.name: Precognitive Strategies
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
stratagems.summary: Make a Normal move of up to D6".

stratagems.name: Shining Resolve
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: -1 to Wound rolls when S > T.

rules.name: Hallowed Ground
rules.effect:
Certain areas of the battlefield are within your army's Hallowed Ground, as follows:

- Your deployment zone is always within your army's Hallowed Ground.

- The area of the battlefield within 6" of one or more **^^Purifier Squad^^** units from your army is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

- At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within No Man’s Land, until the end of that phase, No Man’s Land is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

- At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within your opponent’s deployment zone, until the end of that phase, your opponent’s deployment zone is within your army’s Hallowed Ground.

Each time a model in a **^^Grey Knights^^** unit from your army makes a ranged attack that targets a visible target or makes a melee attack, re roll a Hit roll of 1. If that unit is a **^^Purifier Squad^^** and/or is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground, you can re roll the Hit roll instead.

stratagems.name: Sanctified Kill Zone
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase and that is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or, re-roll the Wound roll instead if your unit is a PURIFIER SQUAD.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Wound rolls of 1; re-roll all Wound rolls if PURIFIER SQUAD.

stratagems.name: Flames of Sanctity
stratagems.timing: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One PURIFIER SQUAD unit from your army that was eligible to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of your unit, adding 1 to the result if your unit includes CASTELLAN CROWE: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.summary: Roll D6 for each enemy unit within 6" (+1 if CASTELLAN CROWE present); 4+ inflicts D3 mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Hallowed Beacon
stratagems.timing: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit (excluding TERMINATOR units) that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Set up your unit wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.
stratagems.summary: Set up unit wholly in Hallowed Ground, >6" from enemies.

stratagems.name: Fires of Covenant
stratagems.timing: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit is set up or ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 6" of your unit, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
stratagems.summary: Enemy unit within 6" suffers D3 mortal wounds on 4+ (2+ if wholly in Hallowed Ground).

stratagems.name: Aegis Eternal
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit that are wholly within your Hallowed Ground have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.summary: 4+ invulnerable save for models wholly within Hallowed Ground.

stratagems.name: Repelling Sphere
stratagems.timing: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy unit declares a charge and your unit is one of the targets of that charge, subtract 1 from the Charge roll, or subtract 2 instead if your unit is wholly within your army’s Hallowed Ground.
stratagems.summary: -1 to Charge rolls against this unit (-2 if wholly in Hallowed Ground).

rules.name: Fury of Titan
rules.effect: Each time a unit from your army is set up using the Deep Strike rule, until the end of the turn, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Channelling
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] to unit's Psychic weapons.

stratagems.name: Combat Manifestation
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that is arriving using the Deep Strike ability this phase.
stratagems.effect: Set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units, but until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.
stratagems.summary: Set up unit more than 6" from enemies; cannot charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Purgation Pattern
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was set up using the Deep Strike ability this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [SUSTAINED HITS 1] to unit's weapons.

stratagems.name: Duty Unending
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit within Engagement Range of one or more GREY KNIGHTS units from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.cond: One of those GREY KNIGHTS units that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.summary: Place unit with Deep Strike into Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Shining Veil
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant Stealth to unit until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Expeditious Exit
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: If every model in your unit has the Deep Strike ability, remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. Designer’s Note: This Stratagem allows you to remove a unit in addition to those removed using the Gate of Infinity rule, and it allows you to remove a unit within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.summary: Remove Deep Strike unit from battlefield to Strategic Reserves (bypasses Gate of Infinity limit; works in Engagement Range).

rules.name: Prescient Redeployment
rules.effect:
From the second battle round onwards, at the start of your Movement phase, if you did not select the maximum number of ^^**Grey Knights^^** units from your army using the Gate of Infinity ability at the end of your opponent's previous turn, you can select one ^^**Grey Knights^^** unit from your army that is on the battlefield that could have been selected using the Gate of Infinity ability. Remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.


**Designer's Note**: *This means that your unit can retain its position on the battlefield at the end of your Command phase, and then be placed into Strategic Reserves at the start of your Movement phase, to set it up again in your Reinforcements step in another position.

stratagems.name: Aggressive Anticipation
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Your unit’s attacks can re-roll hit rolls.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll hit rolls for unit's attacks.

stratagems.name: Appointed Hour
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.summary: Grant [CRITICAL HITS] on unmodified 5+ to unit's attacks.

stratagems.name: Forewarned Evasion
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS WALKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
stratagems.summary: -1 to Hit rolls on all incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Necessary End
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. If the result is greater than the current battle round number, do not remove the destroyed model from play; it can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
stratagems.summary: Destroyed model fights if D6 > current battle round, then removed.

stratagems.name: Redirected Strike
stratagems.timing: End of your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves. Designer’s Note: This Stratagem lets players utilise abilities that retain control of objective markers and react to their missions and objectives with this unit.
stratagems.summary: Unit with Deep Strike can enter Strategic Reserves.

stratagems.name: Mirage of Echoes
stratagems.timing: The Reinforcements step of your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit is set up.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: If your unit has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.summary: Place unit with Deep Strike into Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Mailed Fist
rules.effect: Each time a ^^**Grey Knights Vehicle**^^ unit from your army Advances, do not make an Advance roll for it; until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and, until the end of the turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [**^^Assault**^^] ability.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Will
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.cond: That GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.summary: Feel No Pain 4+ vs mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Abominus-class Targets
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.
stratagems.summary: +1 to Wound rolls against MONSTER/VEHICLE targets.

stratagems.name: Armoured Aegis
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER VEHICLE unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: One model in your unit regains up to 3 lost wounds.
stratagems.summary: Restore up to 3 wounds to one model.

stratagems.name: Redoubled Assault
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.cond: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: Fell Back unit can shoot and declare charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Force Wave
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to move or charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Charge move, it can move horizontally through terrain features.
stratagems.summary: Move through terrain horizontally.

stratagems.name: Argent Wrath
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase, just after a GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit from your army ends a Charge move.
stratagems.cond: That GREY KNIGHTS VEHICLE unit.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 3" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from that test.
stratagems.summary: Enemy units within 3" must take Battle-shock test with -1.

rules.name: Channelled Force
rules.effect:
Each time a **^^Grey Knights**^^ unit from your army is selected to fight, that unit can take a Leadership test. If that test is passed, select one of the following rules. Until the end of the phase, that unit has that rule.
- Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [**^^Psychic**^^] ability also have the [**^^Sustained Hits 1**^^] ability.
- Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit with the [**^^Psychic**^^] ability also have the [**^^Lethal Hits**^^] ability.

stratagems.name: Hexwrought Reprisal
stratagems.timing: End of any phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is on the battlefield and suffered one or more mortal wounds this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit which inflicted one or more mortal wounds on your unit this phase, then roll a number of dice equal to the number of mortal wounds your unit suffered this phase: for each 2+, that enemy unit suffers one mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds). These mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.
stratagems.summary: Roll dice equal to mortal wounds suffered this phase against unit that caused them: 2+ inflicts 1 mortal wound (max 6). Mortal wounds are Psychic Attacks.

stratagems.name: Warding Chant
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1.
stratagems.summary: Models gain Feel No Pain 5+ vs unmodified Damage 1 attacks.

stratagems.name: Chaos Bane
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [ANTI-CHAOS 4+] to unit's ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Celerity
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
stratagems.summary: Eligible to charge after Advancing.

stratagems.name: Circle of Sanctuary
stratagems.timing: Start of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER model from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, enemy units that are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements cannot be set up within 12" horizontally of your model.
stratagems.summary: Reinforcements cannot set up within 12" of your model.

stratagems.name: Shadow of Anarch
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS PSYKER unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit and is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" or, if it has the Deep Strike ability, it can be placed into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.summary: Unit moves 6" or uses Deep Strike to enter Strategic Reserves.

rules.name: Mustering A Boarding Patrol
rules.effect:
You can include up to two of the following units (duplicates are not allowed):
- **^^Brother-Captain^^**
- **^^Brother-Captain Stern^^**
- **^^Brotherhood Champion^^**
- **^^Brotherhood Chaplain^^**
- **^^Brotherhood Librarian^^**
- **^^Brotherhood Techmarine^^**
- **^^Castellan Crowe^^**
- **^^Grand Master^^**
- **^^Grand Master Voldus^^**
- **^^Kaldor Draigo^^**

You can include up to three of the following unit:
- **^^Strike Squad^^** (5 or 10 models)

You can include up to one of each of the following units:
- **^^Interceptor Squad^^** (5 or 10 models)
- **^^Purifier Squad^^** (5 models)

You can include up to one of the following units:
- **^^Brotherhood Terminator Squad^^** (5 models)
- **^^Paladin Squad^^** (5 models)

rules.name: Rules Adaptions
rules.effect:
- The **^^Brotherhood Librarian^^** model loses the Vortex of Doom ability.
- The **^^Grand Master Voldus^^** model loses the Hammer Aflame ability.
- The **^^Interceptor Squad^^** unit loses the Personal Teleporters ability.
- The **^^Kaldor Draigo^^** model loses the One With the Warp ability.
- The **^^Strike Squad^^** unit loses the Sanctifying Ritual ability.

rules.name: An Urgent Duty
rules.effect: Add 1 to Advance and Charge rolls made for **^^Grey Knights^^** units from your army.

rules.name: Eye of the Prognosticars
rules.effect:
Units from your army with the Teleport Assault ability replace that ability with this one.

Each time you target this unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

stratagems.name: Breach-shock
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3".
stratagems.summary: Pile-in and Consolidation moves up to 6" instead of 3".

stratagems.name: Hexbane Wards
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in that enemy unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [HAZARDOUS] to enemy unit's melee weapons.

stratagems.name: Translocation
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One INTERCEPTOR SQUAD or GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
stratagems.effect: The next time your unit is selected to move this phase, models in that unit can move through Walls and closed Hatchways as if they were not there, but when doing so, no model can move more than 6".
stratagems.summary: Models move through Walls and closed Hatchways; max 6" when doing so.

stratagems.name: Sanctified Slaughter
stratagems.timing: Your Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that charged this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. If such a weapon already has that ability, until the end of the phase, each time an attack is made with that weapon, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.summary: Grant [SUSTAINED HITS 1] to unit's melee weapons; if already have it, unmodified 5+ hits are Critical Hits.

rules.name: Mustering A Boarding Patrol
rules.effect:
You can include up to two of the following units (duplicates are not allowed):
- **^^Brother-Captain^^**
- **^^Brother-Captain Stern^^**
- **^^Brotherhood Chaplain^^**
- **^^Brotherhood Librarian^^**
- **^^Grand Master^^**
- **^^Grand Master Voldus^^**
- **^^Kaldor Draigo^^**

You can include up to two of each of the following units:
- **^^Brotherhood Terminator Squad^^** (5 or 10 models)
- **^^Paladin Squad^^** (5 or 10 models)

rules.effect:
- The **^^Brotherhood Librarian^^** model loses the Vortex of Doom ability.
- The **^^Grand Master Voldus^^** model loses the Hammer Aflame ability.
- The **^^Kaldor Draigo^^** model loses the One With the Warp ability.

rules.name: Pre-emptive Strike
rules.effect: In the Reinforcements step of your first Movement phase, you can set up on the battlefield one **^^Grey Knights^^** Reserves unit from your army using the Deep Strike ability. When doing so, you can set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models (measure this distance as you would normally for the Deep Strike ability). Until the end of the turn that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

rules.name: Eye of the Prognosticars
rules.effect:
Units from your army with the Teleport Assault ability replace that ability with this one.

Each time you target this unit with a Stratagem, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control: on a 5+, you gain 1CP.

stratagems.name: Armoured Aegis
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER model from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your model has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant Feel No Pain 4+ until end of phase.

stratagems.name: Sanctic Circle
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS CHARACTER or PALADIN SQUAD unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker within 9” of and visible to your unit. If that objective marker does not have any enemy models within range of it (excluding Battle-shocked models), your unit must take a Leadership test, subtracting 1 from the result if that objective marker is Secured by your opponent’s army. If that test is passed, that objective marker is no longer considered Secured by your opponent’s army and is Secured by your army.
stratagems.summary: Secure objective within 9" if no enemies in range; take Leadership test (-1 if opponent Secured it); pass = flip to your Secured.

stratagems.name: Relentless Boarders
stratagems.timing: Your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to charge this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: Eligible to charge after Fall Back this turn.

stratagems.name: Psybolt Ammunition
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One GREY KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of storm bolters equipped by models in your unit by 1.
stratagems.summary: Improve AP of storm bolters by 1.

rules.name: Dauntless Champions
rules.effect: When a friendly **PALADIN SQUAD** unit is **selected to fight**, if the **S** of those attacks is lower than the **T** of the target, those attacks have +1 to **wound rolls**.

stratagems.name: Truesilver Aegis
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly PALADIN SQUAD unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.cond: That PALADIN SQUAD unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.
stratagems.summary: Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: A Threat Ended

glossary.name: Psychic
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[PSYCHIC]** weapon, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s **BS** or **WS** characteristic and any or all modifiers to the **hit roll**. Attacks made with **[PSYCHIC]** weapons are known as **psychic attacks** (this can be important for the triggering of other rules).

glossary.name: Rapid Fire
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[RAPID FIRE X]**. Each time you gather **attack dice** for a **[RAPID FIRE]** weapon, add **X** additional **attack dice** if the target unit was within half range of that weapon in the Select Targets step. 
***Example:** If a **[RAPID FIRE 1]** weapon with an **A** characteristic of 1 targets a unit that is within half range, you would gather one additional **attack dice** for that weapon (for a total of two for that weapon).*

glossary.name: Ignores Cover
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with an **[IGNORES COVER]** weapon, the target cannot have the **benefit of cover** against that attack (13.08), including from rules that give a model or unit the **benefit of cover** (e.g. **Stealth**).

glossary.name: Torrent
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[TORRENT]** weapon, that attack automatically hits the target.

glossary.name: Sustained Hits
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[SUSTAINED HITS X]**. Each time an attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS]** weapon results in a **critical hit**, that attack results in a number of additional hits on the target as denoted by **X**.
***Example:** An attack made with a **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** weapon results in a **critical hit**. That attack therefore hits the target three times (once from the **critical hit**, and twice more from the **[SUSTAINED HITS 2]** ability).*

glossary.name: Precision
glossary.effect: While resolving attacks made with one or more **[PRECISION]** weapons, at the start of the Allocation Order step (05.03), if the target unit contains one or more **CHARACTER** models **visible** to one or more of the attacking models, the active player can select one allocation group that contains one of those **visible CHARACTER** models. If they do, until those attacks are resolved, or until that **CHARACTER** group is **destroyed** (whichever happens first), that **CHARACTER** group is the current allocation group.

glossary.name: Blast
glossary.effect:
Each time you gather attack dice for a **[BLAST]** weapon, add one additional **attack dice** for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down). If this ability takes the form **[BLAST X]**, each time you gather **attack dice** for such a weapon, add **X** additional **attack dice** for every five models that were in the target unit in the Select Targets step (rounding down) instead. 
***Example:** If a **[BLAST 2]** weapon with an **A** characteristic of 3 targets a unit containing 12 models, you would gather four additional **attack dice** for that weapon (for a total of seven for that weapon).*

glossary.name: Anti
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **[ANTI-X Y+]**. Each time an attack is made with an **[ANTI]** weapon, if the target unit has the keyword denoted by **X**, an unmodified **wound roll** of **Y+** is a **critical wound**.
***Example:** An attack made with an **[ANTI-VEHICLE 4+]** weapon against a ^^**Vehicle**^^ unit will result in a **critical wound** on an unmodified **wound roll** of 4+, while an attack made with an **[ANTI-PSYKER 2+]** weapon against a ^^**Psyker**^^ unit will result in a **critical wound** on an unmodified **wound roll** of 2+.*

glossary.name: Devastating Wounds
glossary.effect:
Each time an attack made with a **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapon results in a **critical wound**, the attack sequence for that attack ends and the target unit suffers a number of **mortal wounds** equal to the **D** characteristic of that weapon. These are inflicted after resolving any normal damage inflicted by those attacks. 
**Mortal wounds** inflicted by **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapons can damage a maximum of one model for each **critical wound**; any remaining **mortal wounds** inflicted by that attack are lost. 
***Example:** An attack made with a **[DEVASTATING WOUNDS]** weapon with a **D** characteristic of 3 results in a **critical wound** against an Intercessor Squad, so inflicts 3 **mortal wounds**. The first 2 **mortal wounds** are sufficient to **destroy** 1 Intercessor model, so the remaining **mortal wound** is lost.*

glossary.name: Extra Attacks
glossary.effect:
Each time a unit containing one or more models with an **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapon fights, those models will make attacks with those weapons in addition to any others. In the Select Weapons step (04.01), for each of those models, you must select: 
- All of that model’s **[EXTRA ATTACKS]** weapons. 
- One of that model’s other melee weapons, if possible.

***Example:** A model targets a unit that is within half range of a **[MELTA 2]** weapon with a **D** characteristic of D6. While resolving those attacks, that weapon has a **D** characteristic of **D6+2**.*

glossary.name: Twin-linked
glossary.effect: Each time an attack is made with a **[TWIN-LINKED]** weapon, you can re-roll the **wound roll**.

glossary.name: One Shot
glossary.effect:
Each weapon with this ability can only be selected to make attacks with once per battle. 
If a **destroyed** model is returned to a unit, all of its **[ONE SHOT]** weapons that have already been selected to make attacks with during the battle cannot be selected to make attacks with again. 
If a new unit is added to an army, all **[ONE SHOT]** weapons in that unit can be selected to make attacks with once per battle.

glossary.name: Firing Deck
glossary.effect:
This ability always takes the form **Firing Deck X**. In your Shooting phase, each time this **TRANSPORT** is **selected to shoot**, if one or more units are embarked within it, resolve the following sequence: 
1. Select up to **X** models embarked within this **TRANSPORT** (excluding models whose units have already been **selected to shoot** this phase). 
2. For each selected model, select one of its ranged weapons (excluding **[ONE SHOT]** weapons). 
3. Until this **TRANSPORT** has resolved all of its attacks, it has all of those selected weapons in addition to its other weapons. 
4. Until the end of the turn, units embarked within this **TRANSPORT** are not eligible to shoot.

glossary.name: Hover
glossary.effect: Each time this unit **takes to the skies** (21.03), do not subtract 2" from the **maximum distance**.

glossary.name: Hazardous

- That unit is **unengaged**. 
- That unit was not set up on the battlefield this turn. 
- No model in that unit has moved more than 3" this turn.
